scope: 12 primary pairs; full per-rater estimates use every attempted run and keep original rater scores. The agreed-only subset and the Grok overlay set are separate; overlay field copies are not rater consensus and are not averages.

time.note: Restricted mean time at the common deadline; unsuccessful runs censored at tau. Successful-only medians are descriptive and can reward fast failures.

efficiency.note: Includes failed and timed-out runs. Neither ratio rewards an unsupported short answer: unsupported claims earn no quality or claim credit in scoring. Null ratio means zero context tokens, reported as N/A rather than given an artificial denominator. Unscored runs contribute tokens to the denominator and are counted in unscoredRuns; a missing score is uncertainty, not zero quality.

notes: parallelLiability is a conservative reserved-liability amount (request-price accounting), not invoice-reconciled spend.
claimsPerParallelDollar is null (N/A) for zero-spend arms: no artificial denominator is introduced; zero spend is shown directly.
supportedClaimsTotal includes all services. claimsPerParallelDollar uses only explicitly Parallel-attributed claims and is unknown if any cost or attribution is missing.
modelCostUsd is a token-price estimate distinct from Parallel charges; provider subscription estimates are not Parallel charges. Null means no prices were supplied: unknown, not zero.

runsWithoutLiability counts records with no liability field (gateway API pending): their liability is unknown and excluded from the sums, not treated as verified zero.

reportingCorrection: Post-run presentation correction: identify the consensus subset size, show complete 12-pair estimates separately for both raters, and read the exact sign-test p field. No worker, gold, rubric, or scoring threshold changed. Previous renderer and output are retained in data/frozen-reporting/. Grok overlay records copy disputed fields from a named original rater; they do not rewrite rater files or invent agreement.
